card.name: Christian book and ministry citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small linking words in Christian bibliographies, author bios and church news, where a religious publisher, school or church comes next.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Colon, period or parenthesis after a Christian book title, right before the publisher or place.
modes.example: Breaking the Da Vinci Code<<.>> Nashville: Nelson, 200

modes.label: Bio and church setting
modes.description: Words like at, is or Church in bios or news about Christian scholars, writers and congregations.
modes.example: senior lecturer in New Testament<< at>> Aberdeen University.

card.writes: It pushes toward church-life words like ministry, fellowship, pastors, Christians and believers.
card.plain: It lights up in Christian writing, such as book citations and church bios, where a religious group or publisher is likely to come next.
